answer: The hollow graph is validated at intake and the trellis frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and wander anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 9 dollars and 5 days per identity, which turns a 3524 account sybil into a 12 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
